title: VTruST: Controllable value function based subset selection for Data-Centric Trustworthy AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of 'Trustworthy AI' by optimizing for fairness and robustness in training data subsets. It does not evaluate religion, spirituality, or specific moral and ethical reasoning frameworks beyond standard algorithmic fairness metrics (e.g., EO and DP disparity) in tabular and image classification tasks.
